open scoped BigOperators

/-- Integer column coordinate of the frozen honeycomb vertices. -/
def bridgeBoxColumn : Vertex → ℤ
  | .up i j => 2 * i + j
  | .down i j => 2 * i + j + 1

/-- A path lies in the two-column-slab box indexed by `-R, ..., R`. -/
def bridgeInColumnBox {h : ℕ} (R : ℕ) (p : BridgePath h) : Prop :=
  ∀ v ∈ p.vertices,
    -(2 * (R : ℤ)) ≤ bridgeBoxColumn v ∧
      bridgeBoxColumn v ≤ 2 * (R : ℤ) + 1

/-- Every finite family of finite bridge paths lies in one common column box. -/
theorem bridgeFiniteSet_commonColumnBox {h : ℕ} (s : Finset (BridgePath h)) :
    ∃ R : ℕ, ∀ p ∈ s, bridgeInColumnBox R p := by
  classical
  let radius : BridgePath h → ℕ := fun p =>
    p.vertices.toFinset.sup (fun v => (bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs)
  let R : ℕ := s.sup radius
  refine ⟨R, ?_⟩
  intro p hp v hv
  have hpR : radius p ≤ R := Finset.le_sup hp
  have hvR : (bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs ≤ radius p :=
    Finset.le_sup (f := fun v : Vertex => (bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs)
      (List.mem_toFinset.mpr hv)
  have hnat : (bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs ≤ R := hvR.trans hpR
  have hcast : ((bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs : ℤ) ≤ (R : ℤ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hnat
  have habs : |bridgeBoxColumn v| ≤ (R : ℤ) := by
    simpa only [Int.natCast_natAbs] using hcast
  obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := abs_le.mp habs
  constructor <;> omega

/-- A bound uniform in the box radius bounds every finite bridge-family sum. -/
theorem bridgeFiniteSum_weight_le_of_uniformColumnBoxBound {h : ℕ} {K : ℝ}
    (H : ∀ (R : ℕ) (s : Finset (BridgePath h)),
      (∀ p ∈ s, bridgeInColumnBox R p) → ∑ p ∈ s, weight p ≤ K) :
    ∀ s : Finset (BridgePath h), ∑ p ∈ s, weight p ≤ K := by
  intro s
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := bridgeFiniteSet_commonColumnBox s
  exact H R s hR

/-- Conditional zeroth-mass reduction. The uniform finite-box bound is an input;
this theorem does not establish that bound or any first length moment. -/
theorem bridgeSummable_weight_of_uniformColumnBoxBound {h : ℕ} {K : ℝ}
    (H : ∀ (R : ℕ) (s : Finset (BridgePath h)),
      (∀ p ∈ s, bridgeInColumnBox R p) → ∑ p ∈ s, weight p ≤ K) :
    Summable (weight (h := h)) := by
  exact summable_of_sum_le (fun p => bridgeWeight_nonneg p)
    (bridgeFiniteSum_weight_le_of_uniformColumnBoxBound H)

/-- The same still-unproved finite-box input also bounds the full bridge mass. -/
theorem bridgeMass_le_of_uniformColumnBoxBound {h : ℕ} {K : ℝ}
    (H : ∀ (R : ℕ) (s : Finset (BridgePath h)),
      (∀ p ∈ s, bridgeInColumnBox R p) → ∑ p ∈ s, weight p ≤ K) :
    bridgeMass h ≤ K := by
  exact (bridgeSummable_weight_of_uniformColumnBoxBound H).tsum_le_of_sum_le
    (bridgeFiniteSum_weight_le_of_uniformColumnBoxBound H)

namespace TheoremOS.FiniteMatrixFirstMoment

open scoped BigOperators Matrix

/-- A finite nonnegative factorization of `c (a+b)` is enough to upgrade its
zeroth moment to its first moment. States whose left or right sequence vanishes
contribute zero, so no reachability or trimming premise is required. -/
theorem summable_firstMoment_of_finite_nonneg_factorization
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {c : ℕ → ℝ} {L R : ℕ → ι → ℝ}
    (hL : ∀ n i, 0 ≤ L n i) (hR : ∀ n i, 0 ≤ R n i)
    (hfactor : ∀ a b, c (a + b) = ∑ i, L a i * R b i)
    (hc : Summable c) : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) * c n) := by
  classical
  have hterm (a b : ℕ) (i : ι) : L a i * R b i ≤ c (a + b) := by
    rw [hfactor a b]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => mul_nonneg (hL a j) (hR b j))
      (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hprod (i : ι) : Summable (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => L p.1 i * R p.2 i) := by
    by_cases hzeroL : ∀ a, L a i = 0
    · simpa only [hzeroL, zero_mul] using
        (summable_zero : Summable (fun _ : ℕ × ℕ => (0 : ℝ)))
    by_cases hzeroR : ∀ b, R b i = 0
    · simpa only [hzeroR, mul_zero] using
        (summable_zero : Summable (fun _ : ℕ × ℕ => (0 : ℝ)))
    push Not at hzeroL hzeroR
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hzeroL
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hzeroR
    have hleftScaled : Summable (fun n : ℕ => L n i * R b i) :=
      Summable.of_nonneg_of_le
        (fun n => mul_nonneg (hL n i) (hR b i))
        (fun n => hterm n b i) ((summable_nat_add_iff b).2 hc)
    have hrightScaled : Summable (fun n : ℕ => L a i * R n i) := by
      refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le
        (fun n => mul_nonneg (hL a i) (hR n i)) (fun n => hterm a n i) ?_
      simpa only [Nat.add_comm] using ((summable_nat_add_iff a).2 hc)
    have hleft : Summable (fun n : ℕ => L n i) :=
      (summable_mul_right_iff hb).1 hleftScaled
    have hright : Summable (fun n : ℕ => R n i) :=
      (summable_mul_left_iff ha).1 hrightScaled
    exact hleft.mul_of_nonneg hright (fun n => hL n i) (fun n => hR n i)
  have hconv (i : ι) :
      Summable (fun n : ℕ => ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, L p.1 i * R p.2 i) :=
    summable_sum_mul_antidiagonal_of_summable_mul
      (f := fun n : ℕ => L n i) (g := fun n : ℕ => R n i) (hprod i)
  have hsum : Summable
      (fun n : ℕ => ∑ i, ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, L p.1 i * R p.2 i) :=
    summable_sum (fun i _ => hconv i)
  have hweighted : Summable (fun n : ℕ => ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * c n) := by
    refine hsum.congr fun n => ?_
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    calc
      (∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, ∑ i, L p.1 i * R p.2 i) =
          ∑ _p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, c n := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro p hp
        rw [← hfactor p.1 p.2, Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp]
      _ = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * c n := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.Nat.card_antidiagonal, nsmul_eq_mul]
  refine (hweighted.sub hc).congr fun n => ?_
  simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  ring

/-- The scalar Green coefficients of a finite nonnegative transfer matrix. -/
def matrixMass {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (u v : ι → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  u ⬝ᵥ ((A ^ n) *ᵥ v)

/-- For a finite entrywise nonnegative matrix and nonnegative endpoint vectors,
summability of the single scalar Green series implies its first-moment
summability, even when invisible states have divergent matrix Green series. -/
theorem summable_matrix_firstMoment
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (u v : ι → ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ A i j) (hu : ∀ i, 0 ≤ u i) (hv : ∀ i, 0 ≤ v i)
    (hc : Summable (matrixMass A u v)) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) * matrixMass A u v n) := by
  apply summable_firstMoment_of_finite_nonneg_factorization
    (L := fun n => u ᵥ* (A ^ n)) (R := fun n => (A ^ n) *ᵥ v)
    (hc := hc)
  · intro n i
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ =>
      mul_nonneg (hu j) (Matrix.pow_apply_nonneg hA n j i)
  · intro n i
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ =>
      mul_nonneg (Matrix.pow_apply_nonneg hA n i j) (hv j)
  · intro a b
    change u ⬝ᵥ ((A ^ (a + b)) *ᵥ v) =
      (u ᵥ* (A ^ a)) ⬝ᵥ ((A ^ b) *ᵥ v)
    rw [pow_add, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec]


end TheoremOS.FiniteMatrixFirstMoment

open scoped BigOperators

/-- Integer column coordinate of the frozen honeycomb vertices. -/
def bridgeBoxColumn : Vertex → ℤ
  | .up i j => 2 * i + j
  | .down i j => 2 * i + j + 1

/-- A path lies in the two-column-slab box indexed by `-R, ..., R`. -/
def bridgeInColumnBox {h : ℕ} (R : ℕ) (p : BridgePath h) : Prop :=
  ∀ v ∈ p.vertices,
    -(2 * (R : ℤ)) ≤ bridgeBoxColumn v ∧
      bridgeBoxColumn v ≤ 2 * (R : ℤ) + 1

/-- Every finite family of finite bridge paths lies in one common column box. -/
theorem bridgeFiniteSet_commonColumnBox {h : ℕ} (s : Finset (BridgePath h)) :
    ∃ R : ℕ, ∀ p ∈ s, bridgeInColumnBox R p := by
  classical
  let radius : BridgePath h → ℕ := fun p =>
    p.vertices.toFinset.sup (fun v => (bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs)
  let R : ℕ := s.sup radius
  refine ⟨R, ?_⟩
  intro p hp v hv
  have hpR : radius p ≤ R := Finset.le_sup hp
  have hvR : (bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs ≤ radius p :=
    Finset.le_sup (f := fun v : Vertex => (bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs)
      (List.mem_toFinset.mpr hv)
  have hnat : (bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs ≤ R := hvR.trans hpR
  have hcast : ((bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs : ℤ) ≤ (R : ℤ) := by
    exact_mod_cast hnat
  have habs : |bridgeBoxColumn v| ≤ (R : ℤ) := by
    simpa only [Int.natCast_natAbs] using hcast
  obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := abs_le.mp habs
  constructor <;> omega

/-- A bound uniform in the box radius bounds every finite bridge-family sum. -/
theorem bridgeFiniteSum_weight_le_of_uniformColumnBoxBound {h : ℕ} {K : ℝ}
    (H : ∀ (R : ℕ) (s : Finset (BridgePath h)),
      (∀ p ∈ s, bridgeInColumnBox R p) → ∑ p ∈ s, weight p ≤ K) :
    ∀ s : Finset (BridgePath h), ∑ p ∈ s, weight p ≤ K := by
  intro s
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := bridgeFiniteSet_commonColumnBox s
  exact H R s hR

/-- Conditional zeroth-mass reduction. The uniform finite-box bound is an input;
this theorem does not establish that bound or any first length moment. -/
theorem bridgeSummable_weight_of_uniformColumnBoxBound {h : ℕ} {K : ℝ}
    (H : ∀ (R : ℕ) (s : Finset (BridgePath h)),
      (∀ p ∈ s, bridgeInColumnBox R p) → ∑ p ∈ s, weight p ≤ K) :
    Summable (weight (h := h)) := by
  exact summable_of_sum_le (fun p => bridgeWeight_nonneg p)
    (bridgeFiniteSum_weight_le_of_uniformColumnBoxBound H)

/-- The same still-unproved finite-box input also bounds the full bridge mass. -/
theorem bridgeMass_le_of_uniformColumnBoxBound {h : ℕ} {K : ℝ}
    (H : ∀ (R : ℕ) (s : Finset (BridgePath h)),
      (∀ p ∈ s, bridgeInColumnBox R p) → ∑ p ∈ s, weight p ≤ K) :
    bridgeMass h ≤ K := by
  exact (bridgeSummable_weight_of_uniformColumnBoxBound H).tsum_le_of_sum_le
    (bridgeFiniteSum_weight_le_of_uniformColumnBoxBound H)

namespace TheoremOS.FiniteMatrixFirstMoment

open scoped BigOperators Matrix

/-- A finite nonnegative factorization of `c (a+b)` is enough to upgrade its
zeroth moment to its first moment. States whose left or right sequence vanishes
contribute zero, so no reachability or trimming premise is required. -/
theorem summable_firstMoment_of_finite_nonneg_factorization
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {c : ℕ → ℝ} {L R : ℕ → ι → ℝ}
    (hL : ∀ n i, 0 ≤ L n i) (hR : ∀ n i, 0 ≤ R n i)
    (hfactor : ∀ a b, c (a + b) = ∑ i, L a i * R b i)
    (hc : Summable c) : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) * c n) := by
  classical
  have hterm (a b : ℕ) (i : ι) : L a i * R b i ≤ c (a + b) := by
    rw [hfactor a b]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => mul_nonneg (hL a j) (hR b j))
      (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have hprod (i : ι) : Summable (fun p : ℕ × ℕ => L p.1 i * R p.2 i) := by
    by_cases hzeroL : ∀ a, L a i = 0
    · simpa only [hzeroL, zero_mul] using
        (summable_zero : Summable (fun _ : ℕ × ℕ => (0 : ℝ)))
    by_cases hzeroR : ∀ b, R b i = 0
    · simpa only [hzeroR, mul_zero] using
        (summable_zero : Summable (fun _ : ℕ × ℕ => (0 : ℝ)))
    push Not at hzeroL hzeroR
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hzeroL
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hzeroR
    have hleftScaled : Summable (fun n : ℕ => L n i * R b i) :=
      Summable.of_nonneg_of_le
        (fun n => mul_nonneg (hL n i) (hR b i))
        (fun n => hterm n b i) ((summable_nat_add_iff b).2 hc)
    have hrightScaled : Summable (fun n : ℕ => L a i * R n i) := by
      refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le
        (fun n => mul_nonneg (hL a i) (hR n i)) (fun n => hterm a n i) ?_
      simpa only [Nat.add_comm] using ((summable_nat_add_iff a).2 hc)
    have hleft : Summable (fun n : ℕ => L n i) :=
      (summable_mul_right_iff hb).1 hleftScaled
    have hright : Summable (fun n : ℕ => R n i) :=
      (summable_mul_left_iff ha).1 hrightScaled
    exact hleft.mul_of_nonneg hright (fun n => hL n i) (fun n => hR n i)
  have hconv (i : ι) :
      Summable (fun n : ℕ => ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, L p.1 i * R p.2 i) :=
    summable_sum_mul_antidiagonal_of_summable_mul
      (f := fun n : ℕ => L n i) (g := fun n : ℕ => R n i) (hprod i)
  have hsum : Summable
      (fun n : ℕ => ∑ i, ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, L p.1 i * R p.2 i) :=
    summable_sum (fun i _ => hconv i)
  have hweighted : Summable (fun n : ℕ => ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * c n) := by
    refine hsum.congr fun n => ?_
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    calc
      (∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, ∑ i, L p.1 i * R p.2 i) =
          ∑ _p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, c n := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro p hp
        rw [← hfactor p.1 p.2, Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp]
      _ = ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * c n := by
        rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.Nat.card_antidiagonal, nsmul_eq_mul]
  refine (hweighted.sub hc).congr fun n => ?_
  simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  ring

/-- The scalar Green coefficients of a finite nonnegative transfer matrix. -/
def matrixMass {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (u v : ι → ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  u ⬝ᵥ ((A ^ n) *ᵥ v)

/-- For a finite entrywise nonnegative matrix and nonnegative endpoint vectors,
summability of the single scalar Green series implies its first-moment
summability, even when invisible states have divergent matrix Green series. -/
theorem summable_matrix_firstMoment
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (u v : ι → ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ A i j) (hu : ∀ i, 0 ≤ u i) (hv : ∀ i, 0 ≤ v i)
    (hc : Summable (matrixMass A u v)) :
    Summable (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℝ) * matrixMass A u v n) := by
  apply summable_firstMoment_of_finite_nonneg_factorization
    (L := fun n => u ᵥ* (A ^ n)) (R := fun n => (A ^ n) *ᵥ v)
    (hc := hc)
  · intro n i
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ =>
      mul_nonneg (hu j) (Matrix.pow_apply_nonneg hA n j i)
  · intro n i
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ =>
      mul_nonneg (Matrix.pow_apply_nonneg hA n i j) (hv j)
  · intro a b
    change u ⬝ᵥ ((A ^ (a + b)) *ᵥ v) =
      (u ᵥ* (A ^ a)) ⬝ᵥ ((A ^ b) *ᵥ v)
    rw [pow_add, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec]


end TheoremOS.FiniteMatrixFirstMoment

    simp only [bridgeLayerColumnCode, layer, bridgeBoxColumn, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
  · congr 1 <;> omega
  · omega
  · omega
  · congr 1 <;> omega

/-- A nodup strip list has at most one vertex for each allowed layer-column pair.
No connectivity, source, terminal, or unproved counting estimate is used. -/
theorem bridgeVertexList_length_le_columnSet
    {h : ℕ} (vs : List Vertex) (hnodup : vs.Nodup)
    (hstrip : ∀ v ∈ vs, 0 ≤ layer v ∧ layer v < (h : ℤ))
    (columns : Finset ℤ)
    (hcolumns : ∀ v ∈ vs, bridgeBoxColumn v ∈ columns) :
    vs.length ≤ h * columns.card := by
  classical
  let image := vs.toFinset.image bridgeLayerColumnCode
  let box := (Finset.Ico (0 : ℤ) (h : ℤ)) ×ˢ columns
  have hsub : image ⊆ box := by
    intro pair hpair
    obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hpair
    have hvlist : v ∈ vs := List.mem_toFinset.mp hv
    exact Finset.mem_product.mpr
      ⟨Finset.mem_Ico.mpr (hstrip v hvlist), hcolumns v hvlist⟩
  have hcard : image.card = vs.length := by
    rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ bridgeLayerColumnCode_injective]
    exact List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hnodup
  have hboxcard : box.card = h * columns.card := by
    simp only [box, Finset.card_product, Int.card_Ico, sub_zero, Int.toNat_natCast]
  calc
    vs.length = image.card := hcard.symm
    _ ≤ box.card := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    _ = h * columns.card := hboxcard

theorem bridgeLength_le_columnSet {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h)
    (columns : Finset ℤ)
    (hcolumns : ∀ v ∈ p.vertices, bridgeBoxColumn v ∈ columns) :
    p.vertices.length ≤ h * columns.card :=
  bridgeVertexList_length_le_columnSet p.vertices p.distinct p.inStrip columns hcolumns

/-- The interval may even be empty; its natural cardinality handles that case. -/
theorem bridgeLength_le_columnInterval {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h) (a b : ℤ)
    (hbox : ∀ v ∈ p.vertices, a ≤ bridgeBoxColumn v ∧ bridgeBoxColumn v ≤ b) :
    p.vertices.length ≤ h * (b + 1 - a).toNat := by
  have h := bridgeLength_le_columnSet p (Finset.Icc a b)
    (fun v hv => Finset.mem_Icc.mpr (hbox v hv))
  simpa only [Int.card_Icc] using h

/-- Exact geometric size bound for the already defined symmetric slab box. -/
theorem bridgeLength_le_columnBox {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h) (R : ℕ)
    (hbox : bridgeInColumnBox R p) :
    p.vertices.length ≤ h * (4 * R + 2) := by
  have hlength := bridgeLength_le_columnInterval p
    (-(2 * (R : ℤ))) (2 * (R : ℤ) + 1) hbox
  have hwidth : (2 * (R : ℤ) + 1 + 1 - -(2 * (R : ℤ))).toNat = 4 * R + 2 := by
    omega
  simpa only [hwidth] using hlength

/-- Index of the two-column slab containing a vertex, using integer floor division. -/
def bridgeBoxSlab (v : Vertex) : ℤ := bridgeBoxColumn v / 2

/-- A finite set of two-column slabs contains at most `2*h` vertices per slab. -/
theorem bridgeLength_le_slabSet {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h)
    (slabs : Finset ℤ)
    (hslabs : ∀ v ∈ p.vertices, bridgeBoxSlab v ∈ slabs) :
    p.vertices.length ≤ 2 * h * slabs.card := by
  classical
  let slots := slabs ×ˢ Finset.Ico (0 : ℤ) 2
  let columns := slots.image (fun q : ℤ × ℤ => 2 * q.1 + q.2)
  have hcolumns : ∀ v ∈ p.vertices, bridgeBoxColumn v ∈ columns := by
    intro v hv
    refine Finset.mem_image.mpr
      ⟨(bridgeBoxColumn v / 2, bridgeBoxColumn v % 2), ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact Finset.mem_product.mpr
        ⟨hslabs v hv, Finset.mem_Ico.mpr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩⟩
    · omega
  have hcard : columns.card ≤ slabs.card * 2 := by
    calc
      columns.card ≤ slots.card := Finset.card_image_le
      _ = slabs.card * 2 := by
        simp only [slots, Finset.card_product, Int.card_Ico]
        rfl
  calc
    p.vertices.length ≤ h * columns.card := bridgeLength_le_columnSet p columns hcolumns
    _ ≤ h * (slabs.card * 2) := Nat.mul_le_mul_left h hcard
    _ = 2 * h * slabs.card := by ac_rfl

def bridgeOccupiedSlabs {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h) : Finset ℤ :=
  p.vertices.toFinset.image bridgeBoxSlab

/-- In particular, a transfer encoding counting occupied slabs has this length bound. -/
theorem bridgeLength_le_occupiedSlabs {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h) :
    p.vertices.length ≤ 2 * h * (bridgeOccupiedSlabs p).card := by
  apply bridgeLength_le_slabSet
  intro v hv
  exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨v, List.mem_toFinset.mpr hv, rfl⟩

/-- The actual maximum absolute column of a finite vertex list. -/
def bridgeColumnRadius {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h) : ℕ :=
  p.vertices.toFinset.sup (fun v => (bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs)

theorem bridgeColumn_natAbs_le_radius {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h)
    (v : Vertex) (hv : v ∈ p.vertices) :
    (bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs ≤ bridgeColumnRadius p :=
  Finset.le_sup (f := fun w : Vertex => (bridgeBoxColumn w).natAbs)
    (List.mem_toFinset.mpr hv)

/-- A length profile using the path's actual maximum absolute column. -/
theorem bridgeLength_le_columnRadius {h : ℕ} (p : BridgePath h) :
    p.vertices.length ≤ h * (2 * bridgeColumnRadius p + 1) := by
  have hbox : ∀ v ∈ p.vertices,
      -(bridgeColumnRadius p : ℤ) ≤ bridgeBoxColumn v ∧
        bridgeBoxColumn v ≤ (bridgeColumnRadius p : ℤ) := by
    intro v hv
    have hnat := bridgeColumn_natAbs_le_radius p v hv
    have hcast : ((bridgeBoxColumn v).natAbs : ℤ) ≤ (bridgeColumnRadius p : ℤ) := by
      omega
    have hhi := Int.le_natAbs (a := bridgeBoxColumn v)
    have hlo := Int.le_natAbs (a := -bridgeBoxColumn v)
    simp only [Int.natAbs_neg] at hlo
    constructor <;> omega
  have hlength := bridgeLength_le_columnInterval p
    (-(bridgeColumnRadius p : ℤ)) (bridgeColumnRadius p : ℤ) hbox
  have hwidth : ((bridgeColumnRadius p : ℤ) + 1 - -(bridgeColumnRadius p : ℤ)).toNat =
      2 * bridgeColumnRadius p + 1 := by omega
  simpa only [hwidth] using hlength
